# Win more jobs with a clear estimate, then see which ones you actually won.

> Free estimate and quote generator: good-better-best options, optional add-ons, tax, deposit, valid-until date, print to PDF, win-rate and follow-up tracking, one-click convert to invoice. No account, no watermark, works offline.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
